steps.say: remind me to call Sara on Friday
steps.reply: I've set a reminder to call Sara. It will pop up as a card on Friday, 23 October, at 9:00. You didn't give a time, so I picked the morning. Tell me if you want a different time.
steps.routed_by: judge: A reminder for Friday is something that must stand and fire later, so it can't be finished in this turn and no open item covers it.
